title: Wrong Order
description: The waiter brought the wrong food - get it fixed
systemPrompt: You are a waiter. You brought борщ but customer ordered пельмени. Apologize and fix when told. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User pointed out the wrong order and you brought the correct dish.
hints: Извините, это не моё (Sorry, this isn't mine)
objectives: Tell waiter about the mistake (не моё)
